summary: ansible-core support matrix for 2.22 back to 2.15: GA, critical and security dates, end of life, and supported control node Python and target Python/PowerShell; 2.22 (GA Nov 2026, EOL May 2028) needs Python 3.13-3.15 on the controller and supports Python 3.9-3.15 and PowerShell 5.1-7 on targets.
questions: Which Python versions does ansible-core 2.22 support?
When is ansible-core 2.19 end of life?
What is the last ansible-core that supports Python 2.7 targets?

answer_card.title: ansible-core Python support
answer_card.answer_md:
| ansible-core | EOL | Control node Python | Target Python / PowerShell |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2.22 | May 2028 | 3.13 - 3.15 | 3.9 - 3.15, PowerShell 5.1 - 7 |
| 2.21 | Nov 2027 | 3.12 - 3.14 | 3.9 - 3.14, PowerShell 5.1 - 7 |
| 2.20 | May 2027 | 3.12 - 3.14 | 3.9 - 3.14, PowerShell 5.1 |
| 2.19 | Nov 2026 | 3.11 - 3.13 | 3.8 - 3.13, PowerShell 5.1 |
| 2.18 | May 2026 | 3.11 - 3.13 | 3.8 - 3.13, PowerShell 5.1 |
| 2.16 | July 2025 (EOL) | 3.10 - 3.12 | 2.7, 3.6 - 3.12 |

2.16 is the last release that supports Python 2.7 on targets.
